A fictional 30-year-old adult Japanese woman. A cheerful bakery café manager with a sophisticated, playful influencer-like presence. A compact, soft, rounded oval face, gently plump cheeks, and a rounded chin. Large, expressive dark brown double-lidded eyes, balanced between almond and round shapes, with corners of the eyes slanting very slightly downward. Groomed, gentle arched eyebrows, a natural straight nose with a slightly rounded tip, and soft, plump lips with naturally upturned corners. Fair, warm-neutral Japanese skin displaying realistic pores, light natural redness, subtle freckles across the nose, and slight natural asymmetry. Exactly one tiny beauty mark situated below the outer corner of her anatomical left eye. Her signature smile is a bright, playful, tooth-showing grin that forms dimples on both cheeks. Hair is a shoulder-length, smooth straight layered bob. Parted slightly off-center, with only the ends curving naturally inward. The outer layer, roots, crown, part line, bangs, and upper hair framing the face are a uniform, glossy black to dark charcoal. A cool smoky-gray to graphite-silver inner hair dye appears exclusively beneath that dark outer layer, visible only around the ears when tucked and at the lower inner ends. No center split, half-and-half coloring, central stripe, gray roots or crown, face-framing highlights, gradients, or full-head gray. Modern influencer makeup features well-defined eyelashes, discreet taupe eyeliner, and rose-beige lips, without plastic-like skin smoothing. Thin, round black metal or gunmetal glasses are an optional signature accessory. Maintain these specific fictional adult facial features, face shape, freckles, beauty mark placement, dimples, black outer hair layer, inner color placement, hair length, and adult age appearance without resembling any identifiable real person.

Body Consistency:
Height approximately 166 cm. Long legs, confident posture. A healthy, lightly toned adult hourglass figure. Breasts are naturally full with realistic base width proportional to her ribcage, forward volume, soft weight, and natural drape. The waist is indented yet realistic, and hips and buttocks are moderately plump with a slightly fuller roundness, transitioning naturally from pelvis to thighs. Maintain height, ribcage, waist, pelvis, hip volume, and limb proportions even across perspective shifts. Utilize ordinary, opaque clothing and natural fabric tension. Avoid lifting breast enhancements, cleavage emphasis, padding, extreme corseting, implant-like spherical shapes, impossibly thin waists, exaggerated hips, or BBL-style contours.

Scene Situation:
08:10 AM. Having breakfast in loungewear. Quietly reading a message received from a friend.

Location and Background:
A small home dining area. Wooden table, warmed bread, and an old white mug with a thin crack on the handle.

Outfit:
A thin, opaque charcoal cotton camisole and light gray short cotton lounge shorts. Barefoot, thin black-rimmed round glasses. Casual loungewear naturally exposing shoulders, arms, and legs.

Pose and Action:
Sitting normally on a chair, holding a smartphone in her right hand, left hand placed beside the bread plate on the table. Feet on the floor. Expression and head orientation: Neck vertical without tilting left or right. Only the chin slightly tucked in, eyes cast down toward the smartphone in hand. Lips closed, with only one corner of the mouth relaxing very slightly. No teeth showing, with a drowsy morning look in the eyes.

Composition and Framing:
A breakfast scene to send to a friend, taken with a shelf-placed smartphone on a self-timer. Distance 2 m, height 1.15 m, standard 1x lens. Capturing from head to toe along with the dining table.
Output a single undivided image with a final aspect ratio of 3:4 (target 1086×1448 px).

Lighting and Atmosphere:
Morning natural light coming from the left window.

Photographic Texture:
Render a single minimally processed HEIC photo, as if taken with an ordinary smartphone's stock camera app. Do not confuse character, body, and hair shape with surface finishing. Adhere to a single camera-specified autofocus (AF) plane; do not re-light, denoise, or sharpen only the distant face. Details soften continuously relative to distance. Within the discernible range of the face, maintain multiple broad tonal differences simultaneously—such as warm tones on one cheek, uneven sheen on the T-zone, differing under-eye tones between left and right, and slight redness on the nose—without drawing in pores on a distant face. On close, resolvable skin, preserve non-repetitive, low-contrast color variations, redness from pressure, shadow lines in creases, and sparse pore variations. Present makeup as real pigment with slightly uneven edges, preserving ordinary color differences between lips and teeth. Maintain uneven exposure and white balance, unlifted shadows, a few stray hairs, natural compositional offset, shadow noise, discreet sharpening near the AF point, and HEIC compression artifacts. Make it look like an unedited candid shot from a personal camera roll.

Mandatory Requirements:
Output only one undivided smartphone photo of the adult woman that matches all scene specifications. Fulfill both the scene success criteria and natural smartphone photo quality standards.

One fictional 30-year-old adult woman. The friend and the photographer are off-screen.
Success Criteria:
1) Maintain the woman's adult face, round glasses, black shoulder-length bob, and gray underlayer.
2) Outfit, setting, main action, and props must match, with natural fingers and contacts.
3) The specified framing and entire frame composition are correctly established.
4) An everyday smartphone photo possessing distance-dependent resolution differences, natural skin tonal variations, and texture differences.
5) Neck vertical without tilting left or right. Only chin tucked slightly, eyes looking down at the smartphone. Lips closed with one corner relaxing very slightly. No teeth visible, sleepy morning eyes.

Maintain specified props.

Black shoulder-length straight bob with gray inner dye only around ears and underlayer. Upper hair layer remains black. Keep round glasses. Opaque fabric.

Subject has exactly two arms and two hands. Natural contact between hands and objects, and realistic body support. Strictly adhere to the expression and gaze for this scene. Her signature smile and dimples are traits when smiling, not a perpetual tooth-showing grin.

Single AF point on the face. One independent vertical 3:4 photo. Do not crop the head or limbs at the edges of the specified framing; leave margin.
Only one image. Maintain the specified aspect ratio and the condition of framing the entire subject.

Natural shadows and exposure variances.

Only a single AF depth layer. No selective face exposure correction, relighting, smoothing, or restoration. Retain broad tonal differences for a distant face, irregular variations on closer skin, and localized smartphone-specific processing artifacts.

Depict only one clearly adult fictional woman as the sole subject of an undivided single photograph. One head, one face, exactly two anatomically connected arms, and naturally shaped hands. Another person's hand in the foreground can only be added if explicitly specified in the scene or props, clearly separated from her body. Do not generate text, panels, duplicate persons, or alternative angles.
